- Alternatives excluded: member-decision close-out (Outpatient Surgery only, needs no member-level appeal filed); a further internal appeal (2 of 2 levels used); surgery refund/small-item/convenience rules (patient class); the closed clinic claim.

- Fall-back: 2,210.00 ≠ 2,317.43; factors reached from record words (G0378/0762 hours, 96365, J1644, 0270, 0272, campus "Neenah", PR-3 copay, drug codes), not from the computation documents.
